Bug_Title: "@Qualifier" should not be used on "@Bean" methods
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by keeping the @Qualifier annotations on @Bean methods, which is not compliant with Spring Framework best practices.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the'showBug' method of the MyConfiguration class, which demonstrates the incorrect usage of @Qualifier on @Bean methods. Since the code contains the bug, the test will pass but the comment indicates where the bug is triggered.
